Hello, I have a [product_name] [article_no] with firmware [version_no]. Can the firmware be updated? How can I access the update download?
A [product_name] with firmware [version_no] and article number [article_no] belongs to the first generation of this hardware. For this version, the firmware cannot be upgraded.

analysis.insight_summary: A user attempts to update the firmware on an older [product_name] module but learns that firmware upgrades are not available for this hardware version. This limitation leads to confusion and disappointment regarding support for maintaining hardware functionality.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expected an upgradeable firmware for their [product_name] hardware and was seeking a simple method to download and apply the update.
